name: Injected private food-draft runtime composition boundary
phase: Specification only; implementation requires separate explicit authorization
objective: Define synchronous, I/O-free composition of injected food D1 access and trusted principal resolution into the existing single-admin service, without runtime acquisition or activation.

input.shape: One trusted composition input object containing database: FoodD1Database, callerResolver: SessionPrincipalResolver, administratorPrincipalId: PrincipalId
requirements: All dependencies are injected only. Use existing FoodD1Database, SessionPrincipalResolver and PrincipalId/parsePrincipalId contracts.
Do not import cloudflare:workers, access globals/environment variables, inspect Wrangler bindings, construct session stores or identity repositories, or select a database.
RIVER_FOOD_DB remains an architectural target only; introduce no runtime/config key for it in FOOD-001E.
Do not trim, normalize, infer, default or hardcode the administrator identity. Concrete administrator configuration belongs to a later trusted boundary.

compositionResult.failure: { ok: false, error: { code: 'configuration-unavailable', message: 'Food draft runtime configuration is unavailable.' } }
compositionResult.fixedFailureMessage: Food draft runtime configuration is unavailable.
requirements: The composition failure code is separate from FOOD-001D's five service-level error codes; do not modify the service result contract.
Expose only the authorized FOOD-001D service in the success value. Do not expose the repository or database through the composition result as an authorization bypass.

Every configuration failure returns the same fixed sanitized message without administrator values, database objects, resolver contents, thrown dependency-access exceptions, SQL/D1 details, stack traces or environment/config values.

structuralValidation: Fail closed for missing input/dependency values, null dependencies and arrays where object dependencies are required. The outer input, database and callerResolver must be non-null non-array objects.
Require callable database.prepare and database.batch, and callable callerResolver.resolve, without invoking them.
Validate administratorPrincipalId through parsePrincipalId; malformed or noncanonical IDs fail closed without normalization.
Catch throwing dependency-property access, including outer input/dependency method getters, and return the fixed configuration failure.
Never fall back to memory persistence, commerce/CRM/insurance/Sesh/identity databases, alternate resolvers or anonymous access.
constructionBehavior: The factory is synchronous and I/O-free, returning a composition result rather than a promise.

During construction never call database.prepare, database.batch, callerResolver.resolve, repository methods, service operations, D1/schema probes or session/identity lookups. Perform structural checks only.

On valid configuration construct D1FoodDraftRepository from the injected database, then SingleAdminFoodDraftService from that repository, injected callerResolver and canonical injected administratorPrincipalId; expose only the service.

Construction success establishes structural composition only. It does not prove database existence, applied migrations, primary consistency, expected schema or resolver trustworthiness. These remain responsibilities of the later trusted runtime caller/integration boundary.
Do not add readiness/approval/sale authority, ownership, audit metadata, timestamps, public access or production activation.
operationBehavior: Preserve FOOD-001D authorization unchanged: resolve fresh on every service operation, authorize before operation validation and repository calls, and deny access without record-existence disclosure.
Denied/unavailable service operations cause zero database calls. Authorized operations reach the composed FOOD-001C repository using the injected database.

Preserve exact operation arguments and repository outcomes, including IDs/versions, recipe references, expected predecessors, optional argument omission, limits/cursors, created/already-present/conflict and found/not-found.

FOOD-001C remains database-semantics authority. Do not duplicate or reinterpret concurrency rules, generate versions, merge revisions, retarget evidence, substitute latest recipes or reinterpret completeness.
tests: Valid construction returns synchronously with the authorized service and zero database.prepare, database.batch, callerResolver.resolve, repository or service-operation calls.
Missing/null/non-object/array outer inputs and dependencies, missing/non-callable prepare/batch/resolve methods, and every malformed/noncanonical administrator ID fail closed.
Throwing getters on input properties and dependency methods return the exact same fixed configuration failure without leaking exception details.
The success result exposes only the service, with no repository/database properties or bypass surface.

After composition authorization resolves independently on each operation, including success followed by denial or resolver failure; denied operations across all operation families make zero database calls.
Authorized operations reach the injected FOOD-001C adapter; recording dependencies verify exact arguments and unchanged repository outcomes without treating fakes as database-concurrency proof.
Configuration errors remain distinct from unchanged FOOD-001D service errors and use the exact fixed code/message with no sensitive values.

Source isolation excludes environment acquisition, Wrangler configuration, routes/actions/UI, River OS authentication booleans, session-store construction, migration execution and unrelated subsystem access.
sourceIsolation: Use only existing food repository/service modules and shared identity types/parsePrincipalId. SessionPrincipalResolver is a contract only; no concrete resolver/session-store construction.
Do not import or reference Cloudflare environment acquisition, wrangler.jsonc, routes/actions/UI, River OS authentication booleans, session-store construction or migration execution.
No commerce/checkout/Stripe, fulfillment/accounting/community/public counters, deployment, insurance/Sesh/creator systems or other unrelated subsystem authority.
deferredScope: RIVER_FOOD_DB binding/configuration, database provisioning, migration execution and runtime environment acquisition.
Concrete administrator ID configuration, request/session resolver construction, routes/UI, River OS action handlers and production activation.
Public product access, commerce/checkout/Stripe, fulfillment/accounting/community/public counters, deployment and production data; no unrelated subsystem changes.
currentTaskBoundary: Create only this specification. Do not implement, modify existing files, stage, commit, configure runtime access, access D1, migrate or deploy.
nextStep: Review this specification before separately authorizing the two-file injected composition implementation.
